# EXP-022 results: free diagnostics on missed people (generated by `edgelab.analysis.exp022`)

Reference people: released AlphaPose test poses (ShanghaiTech, 107 videos); matcher = EXP-011 (cached box conf >= 0.25, IoU >= 0.3 with the keypoint box on the same frame). Detectors: yolov8n-pose (EXP-003) = `/Users/nanh/thesis-data/exp003/cache/L0_E0`; fine-tuned (EXP-013) = `/Users/nanh/thesis-data/exp013-sht/cache/L0_E0`.

## (b) Missed person-frames: never-seen vs intermittent reference tracks

A reference track = one released AlphaPose person id within a video. *Never seen*: no frame of the track is matched. *Intermittent*: matched in some frames, missed in others. Misses of never-seen tracks cannot be fixed by temporal smoothing; misses of intermittent tracks are the ones a temporal detector (TSM) could plausibly recover.

| detector | tracks | never seen | intermittent | fully matched | person-frames | missed | missed in never-seen | missed in intermittent | **intermittent share** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| yolov8n-pose (EXP-003) | 1415 | 715 | 687 | 13 | 187021 | 112958 | 57086 (50.5%) | 55872 | **49.5%** |
| fine-tuned (EXP-013) | 1415 | 163 | 930 | 322 | 187021 | 9954 | 1481 (14.9%) | 8473 | **85.1%** |

Sensitivity (descriptive, not the rule): tracks with >= 24 person-frames only.

| detector | tracks | never seen | intermittent | missed | missed in never-seen | missed in intermittent | intermittent share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| yolov8n-pose (EXP-003) | 1050 | 394 | 650 | 110957 | 55294 | 55663 | 50.2% |
| fine-tuned (EXP-013) | 1050 | 12 | 808 | 9022 | 1103 | 7919 | 87.8% |

Descriptive: share of all missed person-frames lying in intermittent tracks that are matched in >= 50% of their frames (a temporal detector has most to work with there): yolov8n-pose (EXP-003) 10.9%; fine-tuned (EXP-013) 70.0%.

## Decision (plan rule: intermittent >= 30% of missed person-frames -> propose a TSM experiment)

| detector | intermittent share | threshold | propose TSM |
|---|---|---|---|
| yolov8n-pose (EXP-003) | 49.5% | 30% | YES |
| fine-tuned (EXP-013) | 85.1% | 30% | YES |

Plan names the YOLOv8n-pose baseline cache for (b); that row decides: **propose a TSM experiment**. The fine-tuned row is reported for context.

Caveats: the reference is AlphaPose output, not human annotation (EXP-011 threat); a track id that AlphaPose splits or merges changes the never-seen / intermittent classification; a track of length 1 can only be fully matched or never seen.
